= Validation Procedure =

The BITwiki validation procedure ensures epistemic rigor through systematic evaluation:

== Step 1: Source Verification ==
Verify primary sources exist and are accessible. Check for retraction or correction notices.

== Step 2: Citation Chain ==
Trace citations to original claims. Identify citation chaining and circular references.

== Step 3: Expert Consensus ==
Assess degree of expert agreement. Document dissenting positions.

== Step 4: Empirical Support ==
Evaluate quantity and quality of supporting evidence. Note limitations.

== Step 5: Status Assignment ==
Assign epistemic status based on cumulative evaluation. Update [[Has confidence category::]] property.
</onlyinclude>
